about_the_game:
Story

You wake up in complete darkness. Oxygen is critically low. To stay sane, you recall the events of the past few days…

Not long ago, you worked at a mountain observatory, studying a mysterious signal from a distant star. The signal contained a sequence of prime numbers, decreasing each day. Is it a countdown? What happens when it reaches zero?

Uncover the mystery of the signal, make contact with an alien intelligence, and save the one you love.

Features

  • Intriguing story: hard science fiction inspired by Lem, Heinlein, Egan, the Strugatsky brothers, and other classics.

  • Unique style: hand-painted visuals, impressionism + noir, digital oil paints.

  • Touching drama: a love story set against the vastness of space and existential questions.

  • Live soundtrack: operatic vocals, strings, saxophone, and warm analog synths.

  • Linear narrative: no choices, one powerful ending. Pure storytelling.

  • Entirely made by one person.

Gameplay

Mayak is a visual novel with 2D adventure elements — intimate and atmospheric. Expect interactive scenes, exploration, and scientific insights.

Science!

Animated explanations of scientific concepts, including:

  • Interstellar travel

  • Life cycles of stars

  • Signal transmission and decoding

  • And more!

She

Space isn’t so cold when someone you love is there.

  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.1-compatible GPU (or OpenGL 3.3 in compatibility mode), 1 GB VRAM

short_description: A linear hard sci-fi visual novel about first contact, space, and the philosophy of life. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.
